dumbbell_bench_press.note: Latest session was 12-11-9. Keep load fixed and rebuild the total reps before progressing; aim to bring set 3 back toward 10-12 clean.

one_arm_overhead_press.note: Hit 9-9-9. Hold the target steady, let the left arm set the ceiling, and build back toward 10-10-10 with strict posture before progressing.

incline_press.note: First session at the slower tempo came in at 15-13. Keep load and tempo fixed and build set 2 back to 15 before progressing.

lateral_raise.note: At the slower tempo, reps landed at 12-15. Keep the same load and strict setup, and bring set 1 up before progressing.

triceps_extension.note: Set 1 was 15 at 10 kg and set 2 was 12 with 12.5 kg. Standardize the next session at 10 kg with the same tempo and earn a full 2 x 15 clean before increasing load.

bulgarian_split_squat.note: Earned return to 12.5 kg (hit 3x12 clean at 12 lbs). Right leg stronger than left — match reps to left side and keep all sets clean.

romanian_deadlift.note: Hit 3x15 at 3-1-1; progress to 4s eccentric. Load stays the same — the slower tempo is the challenge.

side_plank.note: Keep hips stacked and ribs down; prioritize clean holds over max time.

one_arm_row.note: Topped out again at 19.5 kg with the slower eccentric. Keep the load fixed and add a longer squeeze before changing load or variation.

door_anchor_lat_pulldown.note: The single-arm setup landed cleanly in range at 14-14. Keep the current band setup and build to 15-15 per arm before progressing.

rear_delt_raise.note: Exceeded the rep range at the current setup. Keep the same load, stay pain-free, and make the lowering phase slower before changing anything else.

pullover.note: Keep the single-arm setup at 8 kg per arm and build total reps with clean shoulder motion before returning to 10 kg.

hammer_curl.note: Set 2 ran past the range but set 1 did not. Hold the setup steady and bring set 1 to 15 clean before progressing further.

preacher_curl.note: Hit 15-15 clean. Keep 8 kg fixed and add a brief squeeze at peak contraction before increasing difficulty.

incline_prone_y_raise.note: Exceeded the rep range at 10 lbs. Keep the load fixed and slow the lowering phase while keeping clean lower-trap control before increasing difficulty.

reverse_lunge.note: Keep the load band fixed, but aim to bring the early sets up toward 12.5 kg instead of starting back at 8 kg. Only move all 3 sets to 12.5 kg when they stay clean.

hip_thrust_or_glute_bridge.note: Hit 3x20 at 2-2-1. Keep load fixed and make the eccentric slower before changing anything else.

single_leg_rdl.note: Hit 2x12 clean. Keep load fixed and slow the lowering phase while keeping balance and hip position strict.

paused_goblet_squat.note: Set 2 reached 15. Keep load fixed and bring set 1 up to 15 with the same paused control before progressing further.

abs.note: Hold this steady unless you want to choose a clearly harder but still controlled ab variation next time.

sliding_leg_curl.note: Keep hips up and move slowly through full range. Hold the target steady until both sets stay clean without form fading.

tibialis_raise.note: Use controlled reps for shin and ankle resilience. Keep the target steady and adjust setup or range if heel discomfort shows up again.

bulgarian_split_squat.note: Use strict reps. When all 3 sets are 10+ clean at 12 lbs, return to 12.5 kg.

romanian_deadlift.note: Top of range achieved on all sets; keep load and progress with slower eccentric.

one_arm_row.note: Keep reps in the target range with strict torso control; avoid overshooting early sets and build stable totals.

door_anchor_lat_pulldown.load: INNSTAR Advanced pack (start at moderate tension)
door_anchor_lat_pulldown.note: Add this before rear delt/curl work to cover vertical pulling in combo sessions.

rear_delt_raise.note: Keep this controlled and pain-free. Prioritize clean shoulder motion over load, then build reps before returning to 8 kg.

pullover.note: Keep at least 2 sets after pulldowns; keep smooth shoulder motion and build reps before increasing tension elsewhere.

hammer_curl.note: Reached top of range on both sets. Keep load and add a brief squeeze at peak contraction.

preacher_curl.note: Use strict form with upper arm braced on bench or thigh. Keep target steady and bring set 2 toward 15 before progressing.

update_rules.success_rule: If all work sets land at or above the top of the target range with solid form, make the next session slightly harder using the progression priority.
update_rules.hold_rule: If performance is inside the range but not yet at the top across all sets, keep the target setup the same and aim for more reps next time.
update_rules.fatigue_rule: If reps drop sharply, technique breaks down, or recovery was poor, repeat the same target next time or make the variation slightly easier.
update_rules.hybrid_lower_rule: If hard running/padel in the last 24 hours, high-step/all-day walking the prior day, or leg readiness is 1-2, run a light lower day: first 2 lower lifts only, minus 1 set each, and keep 2-3 reps in reserve.
update_rules.lower_progression_gate: Do not progress lower-body targets based on a light lower day performed under fatigue constraints.
update_rules.deload_rule: In week 4, reduce work sets by about half and stay well short of failure.
update_rules.performance_rule: In week 8, aim to beat your best set or total reps on the first main lift of the day, then keep the remaining work controlled.
